notes.title: [Patch Note] 0.0.3 Demo version
notes.content:
We have improved the overall combat feel and feedback, and the core logic has been updated so that doors remain sealed until a chest is opened when moving between modules.

NPC AI and visuals have been updated, and players can now acquire a wider variety of Artifacts. Additionally, acquired Artifacts now have greater visual impact on both the player and their weapon.
[hr][/hr]Enemy Balancing
Fixed an issue where enemies could not properly climb stairs

Reduced health and increased summon count for standard NPCs

Adjusted NPC death behavior so that they are thrown farther upon defeat
[hr][/hr]Abyss of Yggdrasil
Map name changed to Wretched Rest

Foolish Wisp: Now explodes instantly upon death
[hr][/hr]Forgotten Temple
Victorious Loser: Fixed an issue where the boss would freeze after performing a jump attack

Magnusson the Blasphemer

Fixed an issue where the boss would land incorrectly after a ground slam

Fixed an issue where the boss failed to properly target players when at a distance

Fixed other issues causing the boss to remain idle unexpectedly
[hr][/hr]Content
All doors in a module are now sealed upon entry. They can only be opened after unlocking the chest.

Markers on the minimap, which were previously always visible, are now only activated when the player is within a certain distance.

(For example, chests will only appear on the minimap once you approach them.)

Added more diverse Artifacts with unique mechanics, such as lifesteal, health regeneration, and auto-reload.

Artifact acquisition now applies more visible attachments to the player and their shotgun. Equipping items such as boots or gloves will visually alter the character’s hands and feet.

The overall layout of the Forgotten Temple has been adjusted, with a first pass of visual polish applied.

The Wretched Rest now features a wider variety of dungeon modules.

Added a twin-cat NPC to the shop (interactions to be added in a future update).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/351c12e61eda1c7936df1fd5518b6c035bb916f3.gif"]
[hr][/hr]General
Fixed an issue where Steam Cloud saves could fail

Fixed locations in certain maps where players could get stuck

Corrected typos and revised some NPC dialogues

Adjusted friendly fire ratios based on difficulty (including self-inflicted damage)

Other stability improvements and bug fixes

notes.title: DEVLOG #3
notes.content:
Hello,
This is the director of《Shell Bless the Faithless.》

Following the successful showcase at the Busan Indie Connect (BIC), we’ve been steadily refining the game’s core elements based on the valuable feedback we received. In particular, being selected as a sponsor pick and awarded the “Nicalis Pick” has given us even greater motivation to push forward.

The demo version, which was initially made available only for the online exhibition, will now remain live to gather player feedback continuously.
We will continue to improve the game step by step, and we deeply appreciate your ongoing support.
[hr][/hr]GXG 2025 & Indiecraft
On September 19, we will be participating in GXG 2025 as one of the TOP15 finalists of Indiecraft.

Having advanced to the TOP15, we have already completed the final round of judging and are currently awaiting the results. We’ll do our best to bring back good news.

At the GXG venue, you will be able to play the improved build in person, and those who add the game to their wishlist will receive a Korotto acrylic figure as a gift.

Event Info

Title: GXG 2025 (Game culture X Generation 2025)

Date: September 19 (Fri) – September 20 (Sat), 2 days

Location: Pangyo Station area, Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/b33d2d27ffe8061dba51992820701e5a3cd68b75.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/54587c32f5c59f37495b56c6c5f7bbc524a9ef17.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/7c7fb05f66771eee2455a9d7b1e8d11230bfd55a.png"]


[hr][/hr]Improved Demo
An updated demo build has been uploaded, featuring new content along with improvements to bugs, AI, and overall gameplay polish.

New Artifacts added

Improved enemy AI

Features enhancing hit feedback and combat feel

For full details, please refer to the patch notes.
[hr][/hr]


The demo version will continue to be updated on a regular basis. In addition, we plan to launch a Discord community soon, providing more direct channels to connect with players.

If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions for improvements while playing, please share them with us through the community.

Your feedback and reviews mean a great deal to us, and they truly keep us moving forward.

Thank you.

notes.title: DEVLOG #2
notes.content:
Greetings from the Director of Shell Bless the Faithless.
Welcome back to our second developer update.

It’s been a while since our last devlog—and today, we bring some exciting news we've been quietly preparing behind the scenes.
[hr][/hr]

Team Update
Since showcasing our demo at ILLUSTAR PLAY and PlayX4, we've been hard at work refining and improving key aspects of the game based on your feedback.

In addition to developing new content, we focused on refining the shooting action's feel, enhancing AI pathfinding, and significantly improving the overall quality of our art assets.

Our team has grown from 6 to 11 members.

Thanks to the newly expanded art team, most of the placeholder assets have been replaced, giving our visual direction a much clearer focus. NPC and gear designs that existed only in concept have now entered the implementation stage—and we’re enjoying every moment of it.

We also welcomed a new planner who brings a fresh perspective, helping us sharpen the core shooting experience. Our expanded development team is now better equipped to explore bold and experimental gameplay systems.

While development has kept us busy, we're thrilled to share that we've been selected as one of the TOP 15 teams at IndieCraft, and are now preparing for the second round of judging. We’re looking forward to another offline showcase where we can engage with players directly and hear your thoughts.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/36e1efc3f197175b222e45b7459454ae269900f7.png"]
[hr][/hr]

BIC Festival 2025 Participation & Limited-Time DEMO Release
We’re excited to announce that Shell Bless the Faithless will officially be showcased at the upcoming \[BIC Festival 2025], held next week in Busan, Korea.

In addition, we are releasing a limited-time single-player DEMO, available from today until August 31st.
This build offers 30 to 40 minutes of gameplay along a single route and includes the following content:

2 Shotgun Blessings

2 Stage Themes and a Boss Battle

Interactive Dungeon Objects

Destructible Elements and Environmental Hazards

Basic Dungeon Shop System including Buy, Sell, and Enhence.

Character Customization

Unfortunately, the 4-player co-op demo will not be included just yet—we’ve decided to delay its release slightly to ensure stability and a smoother multiplayer experience.

You’ll be able to play the demo firsthand at our booth during BIC, and those who’ve added us to their Steam Wishlist will receive a small gift at the event. If you’re in Busan this fall, we hope you’ll stop by and say hello.

The demo will also be available through the BIC online showcase and our Steam page. We would greatly appreciate it if you could share your experiences and impressions—it helps us tremendously.

We hope that the essence of what makes a great shooter comes through in this build, and we’re working hard to bring you the multiplayer version soon.

Go to Demo Page

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/e762c67bffbbf889b4b223d49a8bf091d9c31ae0.png"]


[hr][/hr]

Current Development Progress
Our game’s core systems are now firmly in place.

We’ve completed the implementation of various interactive dungeon elements such as shops, vending machines, summoning phones, and shrines.

The current development focus includes:

Expanding the roster of Shotgun Blessings and Skills

Building a narrative and branching system based on NPC interaction

Adding new stage themes and boss encounters

Polishing enemy AI behavior

Refining and stabilizing co-op multiplayer

Our top priorities right now are:
enhancing combat through smarter enemy AI, and implementing unique parts and skill mechanics that can offer exciting moment-to-moment gameplay.

We are also in the process of shaping the out-of-game narrative structure, defining the personality and stories of each NPC to further flesh out the world of Shell Bless the Faithless.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/9842a673b2fab414a107afdd5bfbb58b4813257c.png"]


[hr][/hr]

Together, Further
With this milestone, we feel development has now stepped into the core phase of building the full game.

But to reach wider, deeper, and stranger worlds ahead—we need your support.

Please add us to your Steam Wishlist, and stay tuned for more updates.

Your interest and feedback mean everything to us.



— Team Shell Bless the Faithless

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/3289a083fe975d66e1fdffc9932b328f53ea6390.png"]

notes.title: DEVLOG #1
notes.content:
Hello, I'm the director of 《Shell Bless the Faithless》
I'm thrilled to finally greet you through this first developer log.
After quietly focusing on development for quite some time, it’s exciting to finally introduce our game to the world and start communicating directly with players.


A Journey to Save the Nine Realms
《Shell Bless the Faithless》 is a roguelike shooter set in a world where the traditional mythology of Norse gods is bizarrely intertwined with traces and technologies of modern civilization.
You play as a warrior blessed by the gods, wielding a shotgun and setting out on a journey to save the Nine Realms.
This strange realm—where myth and reality collide—will continue to expand through a cast of diverse gods and unique NPCs, each adding depth to the world.


What Kind of Game We're Making
The game’s core systems and gameplay foundation are already complete, and we’re currently focused on developing the following content:
 A wide variety of Oparts (mysterious items)
 Multi-layered map gimmicks
 Tense and thrilling boss battles
 Randomized events and situational encounters
What we aim to create is a game that ① can be enjoyed casually with friends like a toybox of chaos, ② offers depth and challenge through strategic mastery, and ③ delivers the fundamental thrill that defines the roguelike shooter genre.


First Offline Demo Showcase
We’ll be showcasing our first offline demo at the upcoming Illustar Play indie game showcase,
where players can try the game in person.
Your feedback from the event will be a great help in shaping our development going forward.


Future Devlogs & Community Engagement
Starting with this post, we’ll be sharing regular devlogs covering development updates, behind-the-scenes stories, system design choices, and worldbuilding insights.
We’re also preparing playtest events, community Q&As, and demo showcases to better hear your voices and include players in the process.
We believe building this game should be a shared journey.


Join the Journey
Adding our game to your Steam Wishlist would mean a lot to us.
Our community tab is always open, so feel free to drop by and share your thoughts anytime.
《Shell Bless the Faithless》 is only just stepping onto the starting line.
With you alongside us, we believe this journey can grow into something stranger, stronger—and far more fun.
